pr_title: ESQL: Fix bug in grammar that allowed spaces inside id pattern
pr_body:
Change id pattern into a lexer rule and rely on fragments to avoid
 having whitespaces inside an id pattern

Fix #105441
pr_comments: Hi @costin, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: ES|QL: regression on identifier patterns
issue_context.body:
The fixes introduced by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/105325 seem to have an unexpected side effect:
the following query is parsed correctly (and probably it should not)

```
row a = 10 | rename a as this is fine
```

the output has a field name that is not what is defined in the queries (`thisisfine` vs `this is fine`)

```
  thisisfine   
---------------
10
```
